method: manual rare-label-first; DA and NE split separately

strategy.DA: Manual split into train and held-out subsets, followed by a manual split of held-out into validation and test.
strategy.NE: Deterministic shuffle followed by allocation into the exact remaining global split capacities.

notes: Split comments before creating two-stage ACSA comment/category pairs.
A label with fewer examples than splits cannot occur in every split.
This variant exists for a fair algorithm comparison with the library version.
